column2: # 创建散点图对象，并添加从原点出发的斜对角线
p_Y_X3_2017 <- ggplot(data = df.Fuzzy.4, aes(x = X3, y = Y)) +
geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +  # y = x 线
xlim(range(c(df.Fuzzy.4$X3, df.Fuzzy.4$Y))) +  # 确保X轴范围与Y轴相同
ylim(range(c(df.Fuzzy.4$X3, df.Fuzzy.4$Y))) +  # 确保Y轴范围与X轴相同
